job.title: Solution Consultant (m/w/d) - PIM / MDM
job.email_subject: Application: Solution Consultant PIM / MDM – Kranti Chavan
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

You need a PIM / MDM consultant who knows how product data really travels between systems – I built and optimized PIM-to-commerce pipelines with Profisee at Rockwell Automation.

– PIM-to-Hybris pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub; SAP ERP / MDM integration
– Requirements analysis, user stories, functional specifications and UAT with business teams
– Product catalog, data modeling and SQL performance tuning on SAP Commerce

I combine the consulting view with the technical depth to make PIM / MDM solutions work end to end with ERP and shop systems. My CV and cover letter are attached. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. Could we arrange a short call this week or next?

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Solution Consultant PIM / MDM | Profisee, SAP ERP & Commerce Data Integration
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional consultant with 5+ years designing and optimizing PIM / MDM data integrations for enterprise commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris) at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Built PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee with international teams. Strong in requirements engineering, data modeling, process mapping, functional specifications, solution design and UAT, backed by Java, SQL and REST APIs. Uses generative AI tools for analysis and documentation.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Hiveway focuses on PIM and MDM, which is the area of my work I find most impactful: clean product master data that powers every channel. Having integrated Profisee MDM, SAP ERP and SAP Commerce at Rockwell Automation, I want to bring that end-to-end data experience to your clients' projects in Heidelberg.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am applying for Solution Consultant PIM / MDM at Hiveway: built PIM-to-commerce pipelines with Profisee, DataHub and SAP ERP at Rockwell Automation, 5+ years techno-functional. Karlsruhe-based, close to Heidelberg. Glad to talk!

en.subject: Application: Solution Consultant – PIM / MDM
en.hook: Hiveway's PIM / MDM projects succeed when product data flows cleanly from master data into every sales channel. That is exactly what I have worked on: at Rockwell Automation I designed, built and optimized PIM-to-commerce data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, keeping product catalogs synchronized across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: PIM / MDM integration
bullets.text: Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub; investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee with international technical teams.

bullets.label: Requirements & solution design
bullets.text: Analysed requirements with business stakeholders and product owners, wrote user stories and functional specifications, mapped processes and supported user acceptance testing (UAT) – then translated them into working SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Product data in commerce
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality for product, catalog, pricing and customer data on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211); developed and maintained the Promotions Engine, Order Management (OMS), Cronjobs, Impex and FlexibleSearch.

bullets.label: Data quality & stability
bullets.text: Engineered API migrations for customer account structures, improving system stability and data consistency, and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee.
